events.event: Created the two required timeline files before repository or provider mutation.

Read the execution contract and source plan; refreshed Snacks forward; verified GitHub and Vercel authentication; checked only the SOL targets; froze official source, dependency, protocol, and licensing inputs.
Initialized forward, committed truthful governance and timing records, created the private SOL repository, and pushed the only expected direct bootstrap commit.
Explicit default-branch edit returned HTTP 422 immediately after push; direct reads then proved forward was already the default and only branch.
First branch-protection write returned a provider HTTP 503; follow-up read confirmed protection was not yet applied.
Retried the same bounded protection request after the transient provider failure and verified the enforced no-direct-push policy.
First deterministic Get Time bundle measured 539002 bytes and correctly failed the 524288-byte resource ceiling.
Completed the size-bounded UI adaptation; all six resources measured between 335863 and 354133 bytes.
First strict typecheck exposed the Terser target literal, unchecked manifest indexing, and named mcp-handler export mismatches.
Corrected the four integration type contracts; strict tsc --noEmit passed.
All six current 2026-07-28 and all six legacy Streamable HTTP contracts passed, including isolated tools/resources, ordinary fallback, repeated cycles, and 20 representative clients.
The official ext-apps AppBridge declaration entrypoint failed strict NodeNext resolution because its published declarations use extensionless internal imports.
Isolated the third-party declaration defect behind a narrow typed browser-test runtime shim; strict checking remained enabled and passed.

The first Playwright run exposed a development-only asset routing collision: the screenshot route intercepted the gallery CSS and JavaScript, breaking copy behavior and the 320 px layout. Three additional failures were locator ambiguities in the new test harness.
Repaired development asset fallthrough and stable test locators; all six MCP App UIs initialized in the official AppBridge host and all ten browser/accessibility checks passed.
Typed linting rejected object spread over the full HeadersInit union, correctly identifying unsafe behavior for tuple-array header inputs.
Replaced generic header object spreading with the platform Headers API and reran lint, typecheck, gateway tests, and browser checks.
The first repository secret scan falsely matched the uppercase VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL identifier because the credential-prefix expression was case-insensitive.
Scoped the Vercel credential prefix to its real lowercase token form; the repository-wide scan passed without suppressing token-shaped values.
The production dependency audit passed; the complete audit found the moderate GHSA-48c2-rrv3-qjmp advisory in the direct development YAML dependency at 2.8.1.
Upgraded the exact YAML development dependency to patched 2.8.3 and regenerated the lock and SBOM; the complete audit returned no known vulnerabilities.

The first complete local release:check:ci passed: frozen install, formatting, lint, strict types, 42 Vitest checks, 10 Playwright checks, notices, provenance, architecture, full audit, source and secret scans, SBOM, deterministic resources, public gallery, and production-shaped build.
Committed the coherent green implementation, generated artifacts, tests, security/provenance controls, and truthful running timeline on sol/gallery-v1.
Pushed sol/gallery-v1 and opened ready pull request 1 against forward with the bounded architecture, safety, provenance, verification, limitation, and rollback record.
Release check, CodeQL, locked audit, and public-readiness checks passed on the exact PR head; dependency review skipped because the repository was still private as required by the release sequence.
Vercel rejected Git connection for the private organization repository on the Hobby plan; the project remained correctly configured and manual Preview became the bounded interim path.
An unqualified first Vercel deploy unexpectedly created a Production-target deployment and assigned the stable alias despite project-level automatic-domain controls.
Removed the prematurely assigned stable alias, retained the immutable deployment for auditability, and changed subsequent commands to explicit target flags.
The explicit target=preview deployment became ready at the exact a315b24 PR head after a 70-second provider build.
Direct Preview verification reached Vercel Authentication rather than the application; preserved Standard Protection and selected the provider-supported automation-bypass path.

A diagnostic projection exposed the first automation-bypass secret because Vercel represents it as an object key; revoked and regenerated it before any further proof, then handled only the rotated value in ephemeral process state.

Exact Preview network proof passed all six current and six legacy MCP contracts, public metadata and headers, malformed and oversized boundaries, disallowed methods, and post-abort health. A preceding verifier-only doctype-case false negative was corrected.

All six deployed MCP App UIs initialized and interacted through the independent AppBridge host, but the exact Preview gallery overflowed by 36 pixels at 320 pixels because its full build SHA was unbreakable.

Added safe wrapping for code values and made local browser proof always use a production-length SHA; build, 42 tests, and all ten browser checks passed locally. DEP-002 remains Failed pending a replacement Preview.
Replacement DEP-003 at exact head cd7fc1d passed the complete network verifier and all ten deployed browser checks, including six AppBridge interactions and the repaired full-SHA 320-pixel layout.
Recorded the exact Preview verdict as a commit status and required release-check, CodeQL, locked-audit, public-readiness, and vercel-preview-proof with strict up-to-date branch protection.

A fresh single-branch clone at exact head cd7fc1d passed release:check, including frozen installation, the full local matrix, scans and audits, deterministic generation, and a production-shaped Vercel build.

GitHub rejected the green rebase merge because the organization requires signed default-branch commits and GitHub cannot sign an automatic rebase result; selected the allowed signed squash path without changing the PR.

The signed squash merge remained blocked by the active organization ruleset requiring an approval from someone other than the last pusher and a persisted Code Scanning result; repository-local protection correctly could not bypass the parent policy.

After exact Preview, clean-clone, legal, license, provenance, secret, dependency, security, and public-readiness gates passed, changed only the namespaced repository to public so the parent Code Scanning rule and Vercel Git connection could operate.

Connected the exact public GitHub repository to the exact Vercel project; Vercel derived forward as Production Branch and retained Node 24, Hono, frozen install, explicit build, and no automatic custom-domain assignment.
The first public dependency-review job failed because GitHub's dependency graph had not yet been enabled on the newly public repository; the independent locked production audit remained green.

The first native Git-linked Preview DEP-004 became ready and the Vercel check passed at exact documentation head f1a208c; it was not promoted or manually re-proved because the public security run required a source repair.
The first persisted public Code Scanning policy check failed with one real high-severity partial PURL-encoding alert and three alerts inside the immutable non-runtime upstream provenance snapshot.
Added a transparent same-repository release-approval job that can approve only the exact PR head after the complete release-check passes; all independent parent and repository gates remain enforced.
Enabled the namespaced public repository's dependency graph, secret scanning, and push protection, without enabling paid capacity or automatic dependency-update writes.

Replaced partial package-name substitution with complete URI component encoding in the SBOM generator. Kept the frozen snapshot scanned and dismissed only its three non-runtime findings with explicit immutable-source and synthetic-data rationale.

The first alert-dismissal request used a typographic apostrophe not accepted by GitHub's exact enum and returned HTTP 422 without mutation; retried with the documented ASCII enum and verified all three intended alert states.

The governance and PURL correction candidate passed the complete local release:check:ci, including 42 Vitest checks, ten browser checks, audits, scans, notices, deterministic generation, and production build.

The closing exact-head native dependency-review action still reported that dependency review was unsupported after public visibility; the required exact-head locked-audit fallback completed successfully five seconds later.
The final native Git-linked protected Preview DEP-005 became Ready at exact PR head ba648fd and Vercel's native status passed.
Exact-head CodeQL analysis and policy passed after the PURL repair and frozen-source dispositions; zero CodeQL alerts remained open.
The exact-head complete release check passed and the transparent head-bound GitHub Actions review supplied the inherited non-last-pusher approval without bypassing any independent gate.

Exact protected Preview proof passed the public surface, six current and six legacy MCP contracts, failure boundaries, post-abort health, all ten browser checks, and all six App renderings; published the required commit status.
Merged PR #1 by verified signed squash to forward as b0108c71a58289d111674c2f7315bb8e3355113a after every mandatory exact-head gate passed.
Native Git Production deployment DEP-006 became Ready from exact forward SHA b0108c71 with no stable-domain cutover.
Forward CI, CodeQL, public readiness, native Vercel, and zero-open-alert verification all completed green at exact merge SHA.
The exact staged Production deployment passed full network and browser proof plus three complete dual-protocol canary rounds while the stable origin remained withheld.

A local host-inventory diagnostic over-read process arguments and transient sensitive environment values. Stopped process inspection immediately; no value was committed, uploaded, or copied into evidence.
Completed 1,261 continuous seconds of staged observation with 18 of 18 full dual-protocol/boundary/recovery samples passed, repeated browser rendering, and two safe 64-client concurrency bursts.
Promoted exact staged deployment DEP-006 without rebuilding; automatic domain assignment remained disabled.
Explicitly attached only the namespaced stable project domain to the already-proven deployment, then passed the complete unprotected stable network and ten-test browser matrix at exact SHA b0108c71.

Installed OpenWork 0.18.26-alpha.2371 reported three isolated SOL servers Ready before concurrent control switched the shared app; stopped without touching unrelated work. No safe non-metered second MCP Apps host was available.
Established the public evidence cutoff after stable and host attempts; began final README, benchmark report, structured result, and timeline publication work.

Passed the complete local release check for the report-publication tree, including formatting, lint, strict types, 42 unit/contract tests, ten Playwright tests, audits, provenance, deterministic generation, architecture checks, production build, and linked Vercel production build.
